subject: Rolling gates: procurement + legal milestone ladder for pilot (MSA/DPA/order form)
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orthomedics.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orthomedics.com>

Subject: Rolling gates for Redwood pilot: MAP + timeline

Hi Irene / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. Procurement and Legal asked that we put a clear milestone ladder (rolling gates) together so they can sign off internally.

High-level asks from my side:
- Can you provide a MAP that sequences Security review (SOC2 evidence), Legal review (MSA/DPA), Procurement (PO), and Order Form signature?
- We need estimated durations per gate and a minimal set of acceptance criteria for the pilot so our PMs can align internal stakeholders.
- Procurement prefers a deterministic path: Security -> Legal -> PO -> DocuSign. Legal may need an initial redline window.

I attached a quick worksheet (MAP-redwood-v1.xlsx) with our suggested dates — feel free to adjust.

Primary constraints on our side: the security review team needs evidence within the first 5 business days, and Finance says PO issuance can take up to 7 business days after final commercial sign-off.

Can we lock a 30-minute sync tomorrow to agree owners and the final timeline?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of IT Procurement
OrthoMedics Inc.

Attachments: MAP-redwood-v1.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orthomedics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rolling gates for Redwood pilot: MAP + timeline

Samantha — really appreciate the clear asks. I sketched a "milestone ladder" below that maps your rolling gates to owners and minimum acceptance criteria. I've attached a slightly annotated MAP so your Legal/Security leads can see the deliverables per gate.

Proposed milestone ladder (targeted pilot close in ~3 weeks if no major redlines):
1) Security intake (Owner: OrthoMedics Security) — days 0–4
   - Deliverables: SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, minimal data flow, List of data retention settings
   - Acceptance: Security engineer signs off on evidence completeness

2) Legal redline window (Owner: OrthoMedics Legal / Redwood Legal) — days 5–9
   - Deliverables: MSA draft redlines, DPA comments, any vendor-specific clauses
   - Acceptance: Commercial lead confirms final markups or escalates specific clauses for SLA/escrow discussion

3) Commercial alignment & order form prep (Owner: Redwood Sales — Ben) — days 10–12
   - Deliverables: final order form, pricing confirmation, billing contact
   - Acceptance: Sign-off by Procurement business owner that order form reflects agreed terms

4) Procurement PO issuance + DocuSign signature (Owner: OrthoMedics Procurement) — days 13–19
   - Deliverables: PO, executed order form in DocuSign
   - Acceptance: Finance confirms PO and Redwood receives fully executed DocuSign copy

Notes and fallbacks:
- If Legal requests material redlines (>3 clauses), plan for a 5–7 day extension and schedule an escalation call.
- For the security gate, we can accept SOC2 snapshot + in-progress evidence for the pilot if your security team agrees; full SOC2 package can be exchanged during ramp to production.
- Billing: Redwood can accept a one-time PO reference for the pilot; invoice timing can be net-30 or split by milestone upon request.

Next steps:
- Ben will confirm pricing/order form language (I cc'd him).
- Samantha, can you confirm Security contact and Legal primary? If you can share SOC2-snapshot.pdf and a network diagram by EOW we can start the intake immediately.

I attached: MAP-redwood-v1.xlsx (annotated) and a sample order_form template (orderform-draft.docx).

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP-redwood-v1.xlsx, orderform-draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orthomedics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 12:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rolling gates for Redwood pilot: MAP + timeline

Irene — thanks, that ladder looks good to me. Quick clarifications:
- Pricing: the orderform-draft has pilot credits + standard overage rates. I can compress the commercial alignment window to 2 business days if Security/Legal timelines stay tight.
- Billing terms: Finance prefers PO -> invoice net-30. If they need a split invoice (50/50), we can accommodate but need it flagged now.

On the security gate: can we propose a 5-business-day expedited review? Redwood can provide a short onboarding checklist and a named SRE to take questions — might shave 2–3 days off the intake.

If everyone is aligned, I'll update the order form and push DocuSign template link to Samantha.

— Ben
